candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All Japanese entries, readings, indices, and 〔人名〕 tags match the image exactly (including the reading forms ちょうほう, さいそく, かいだん, あいまい without する/な). Supplied English glosses are accurate dictionary translations throughout. Layout as a line-per-entry list mirrors the image well.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Fully faithful transcription: all entries, readings, and indices match, 〔人名〕 preserved. Glosses are accurate; the added '(name)' after Nixon/Sato is a harmless expected gloss. Slightly terser glosses than A (e.g., 誘う 'to invite' only), but nothing incorrect.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Misreads こうした as ごうした and invents an incorrect gloss 'stubborn; obstinate'. Alters printed readings by appending する/な (ちょうほうする, さいそくする, かいだんする, あいまいな) where the image shows the bare readings. Replaces 〔人名〕 with '[person name]' rather than preserving the Japanese label, and omits an English gloss for ニクソン. Uses ～ instead of 〜.

rationale: A and B are both essentially perfect against the image: every kanji, kana reading, index number, and 〔人名〕 tag matches, and all supplied glosses are accurate dictionary translations as the pipeline expects. A edges out B only on marginally fuller, more informative glosses (e.g., 誘う, さすがに). C is clearly last: it contains a genuine character misreading (ごうした for こうした) compounded by a fabricated wrong gloss ('stubborn; obstinate'), silently changes several printed readings by adding する/な, and replaces the 〔人名〕 labels with English bracketed text, losing fidelity to the source.
